title: bee herding run: spawn, mailbox wait, health check, pane lifecycle
action: New verb bee herding run (herding/run.rs, try_native arm in herding.rs). Flags: --task|--task-file, --cwd, --job-id, --idle-timeout, --ceiling, --close-always, --main-root, --json, --dry-run. Flow per D1/D5/D6/D9: write job.json via mailbox module; spawn worker (herdr pane split --cwd, agent start from herding.agent_command tokens, prompt = rendered brief); native poll loop — stat result-N.json, log.txt mtime, herdr agent list — heartbeat idle-timeout kill plus absolute ceiling, zero-token; on valid result close pane (herdr pane close), on failure/timeout keep pane, --close-always overrides; append dispatch.jsonl row and wave-ledger record-worker row; result JSON to stdout. --dry-run renders job.json + brief, spawns nothing. Registry: hand-add herding.run entry to generated/registry_payload.json (regen does NOT write it) with examples[0] = the --dry-run form so registry_dispatch executes it green in a scratch tempdir without herdr and without tripping refusal markers. Gitignore: add .bee/mailbox/ to GITIGNORE_BLOCK_PATTERNS (onboard/templates.rs, order load-bearing) and re-render the block into .gitignore. Seam-test poll/lifecycle decisions with fakes, no real herdr (FakeBackend pattern in wave.rs).
